Slide 5 imports owned DrawingML specimens with consecutive breaks and trailing paragraph-end styles; the alternative selects 36 pt rather than 6 pt empty lines. Native marker baselines cover regular DejaVu Sans, top alignment and zero insets. Slide 6 preserves six native 290 by 160 pt frames covering exact and non-100% percentage spacing, standard/Windows line-height compatibility, and top/center/bottom anchors. The alternative selects captured font-scale and line-spacing-reduction cases, including centered/bottom anchors. These references use calibrated left-to-right ASCII and regular DejaVu Sans. Latin layout follows native separate-letter glyphs; standalone shaping is a separate operation. Slide 7 retains six native glyph specimens per option, comparing explicit scalar positions and painted ink dimensions; the alternative selects scaled originals. Public fitted copies are separate.
